description: Tests whether ANY constant-kernel recursion at depth ≤ 3 covers the c_4 structural-vs-fitted gap. Result: NO. The lower rungs (c_2..c_5) and the σ-action tower (c_6..) are governed by different structural patterns; no single constant-kernel can bridge them. Extends PR #1786's empirical refutation (q₀-noise level) to the structural closed-form level. EXPLORATORY. No production wiring.
verdict: Both tests REFUTE constant-kernel recursion covering the c_4 gap. c_4 has a structurally distinct categorical origin from c_6+ (the σ-action tower) — fixing the gap requires either a k-dependent kernel (CKRecursion R allows this in principle) or a separate derivation of c_4.
